verdict_raw:
Not CLEAN — 3 issues found:

1. **Clipped toolbar item (top-right)**: The last toolbar button is truncated mid-word at the viewport edge, reading "Labe" (presumably "Labels"), and may have more items hidden beyond it. The toolbar overflows horizontally at 1280px. Fix: add horizontal scrolling/overflow handling, condense labels into an overflow "…" menu, or shorten labels (e.g., icons with tooltips) so all items fit within the viewport.

2. **Ambiguous stacked notifications (top-center)**: "↑ Grid at Y=4 ft" (dark toast) and "Daytime" (pill) are stacked directly on top of each other with no visual distinction between a transient notification and what appears to be a persistent state chip — a new user can't tell if they're buttons, statuses, or alerts. Fix: separate them (e.g., toast top-center, Daytime state chip anchored near the Season control or bottom bar) and style the toast to auto-dismiss.

3. **Peeking dialog underlay (left-center, behind modal)**: A white settings panel labeled "Measure / Atmosphere" (plus truncated rows above) sticks out from behind the Social Sharing Card modal with its text visibly cut off mid-row. Functionally acceptable for a modal overlay, but it looks untidy and momentarily reads as broken. Fix: dim/backdrop it with a scrim (it currently appears at full opacity), or close/dismiss the panel when the modal opens.

Everything else looks solid: the modal is well-centered, its purpose ("Generate a beautiful preview card to share on social media") is instantly clear, the card preview with "My Backyard Design / 50ft × 100ft • 3 objects" matches the editable input, the Regenerate / Download PNG / Close actions are obvious, and the left palette, status bar, scale bar, zoom controls, and compass are all legible and non-overlapping. A new user would understand this screen within ~5 seconds once items 1–2 are addressed.
